response.text: The dictionary says APINVH has a V (void) status, but none appear in the data. Next I'll check the amount sign conventions, whether the journals balance, and whether the AP invoice totals match the payments and journal lines.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_balance' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_both_or_neither', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE ("DR_AMT" IS NOT NULL AND "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT" IS NOT NULL AND "CR_AMT"<>0) OR (COALESCE("DR_AMT",0)=0 AND COALESCE("CR_AMT",0)=0) UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_amounts', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_jrnl_lines', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE TRIM(a."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD")) UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE TRIM(v."VEND_CD")=TRIM(i."VEND_CD")) UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_missing', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID");

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_AMT", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) AS paid, COUNT(p."PAY_ID") AS npay, i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO" ORDER BY i."INV_ID" LIMIT 15;
